methods.returns: ImportResult { ok, path, url, dryRun, manifest, counts, created, updated, skipped, failed, deleteJson }
methods.doc: Upsert the generated NPCs from worlds/<world>/actors.json. Run { dryRun: true } first. A thrown PentarynAbort means nothing was written (version gate, @ref lint, malformed entry, fetch, non-GM); a thrown PentarynAssertionError means a readback failed and the batch is partial (actors before it were written). Per-actor write failures do not throw: they come back as { ok: false, failed: [{ slug, error }] }.
Live smoke checks after a sync: published, the module.json gate flags present, the legacy root.
